$comment: Copy me per build and rater. Anchors: ../eval-fun/docs/FRAMEWORK.md section 3, idle boundaries: docs/FUN_EVAL_IDLE.md. One quoted observation per axis. bot: green|amber|red|na is a cap, never an award. Answer criterion + idle probes BEFORE awarding.
evaluator: blind-b (Claude agent, fresh blind rater, seed 149)

activeIntervalsUTC.excluded: ~1.7 min (30 s scroll timeout, ~40 s selector fiddling, 30 s idle wait at end)

horizon.runsWatchedNote: Genuine 1x normal speed only ~6 min total: run1 05:38-05:39, run2 05:41-05:42, and 06:45:39-06:49:50 (one several-minute 1x watch ending in a live death). Other watches were at 'fights only 16x' because that choice persisted from run 3 and I did not notice until 06:45. Requirement of 2 several-minute 1x watches is only partly met (one).
horizon.ruleEditsNote: Attempt 1 (05:53) locked: 'Meet Bloat Mother / or 120h elapsed'. Pen unlocked ~06:02. Completed: return 25->40%; new rule boss->throw fire; +depth>=13; return 40->30%; applied death fix 'hp<30% · foes>=2 -> retreat'; new 'foe: mirror -> throw fire' (after rejecting 'foe: mirror -> retreat', forecast death 13->88%).
deviations: Driver port 5397 instead of 5357: 5357 is held by Windows HTTP.sys (503 Service Unavailable).
Absences were simulated via ?absent= per contract; not same-day-separated in real time.

axes.proxy: time-to-first-rule-edit; misread rate on the trace
axes.note: Forecast deltas made edits legible ('VS LAST RUN · D14 88→50% · death 63→0%'), but they misled: after 'D29 25→100%' the run ended D15 'hp 7/25 · max -26' from hunger never explained; 'Secured $0' for whole deep runs unexplained; 'compare outcomes all similar' nearly every time.

Real trade-off on the return threshold (40%: 'D14 50%, death 0%' vs 30%: 'D14 63%, death 38%'), forge armour vs weapon, tactic slots; but many buys were strictly better and tactic/personality compares said 'all similar'.

I learned from the trace that 'return at 30%' turns him home without disengaging ('return at 30% 9/55 ... mirror king −14 0/55') and later that retreat fails when 'foes hold the way'; repeat King returns showed the next lesson but no clear way to learn 'cadence'.
Carried gold really at risk ('died · kept $0 · $3635 lost') and the live King fight with 'RETREAT' then 'LUCK · bad luck · 1 in 12' made me sweat; most resolution happened offline or at 16x.

axes.proxy: frame time; events per minute at 1x
axes.note: Callouts 'WARLORD BREAKS / GOBLIN WARLORD DOWN', 'REFLECTED!' land on GPU at 3x; at 1x in the Deep long walls of 'lurker → Rook Ash · blocked/miss'; a 'Run ended' replay kept showing hits for ~1 min. Audio unassessed.

axes.proxy: death-cause entropy; distinct situations per run
axes.note: Lanes changed play: 'iron golem: reflect_melee' made me take mirror read, Bloat Mother made me write throw fire, heir bones 'Found heir 1's bones: 12 items'. Lapse: D13 'recently looted · shallower' returns repeated several times and hunger ('The floor is hungry. Find light.') never became something I could act on.

'Guarded + deep march + mirror read, unbowed, return at 30%, throw fire at boss below D13' is mine, but four of five rules and all tactics are packaged and 'RULES chores 66% · attack nearest 21%' dominate.

Reels carry turns: 'The King took him to 13 HP; read the mirror; returned. The Queen cornered him to 24 HP; drank; first boss.' but they are formulaic and the best story (D28 deep run) was only visible as summary chips.

axes.proxy: run length; check-in length; dead time at 1x
axes.note: Check-ins bounded (2-6 min) and 20m/4h/8h distinct; friction from sheets that ignore Escape, two-tap confirms, accidental slot replacement, and dead 1x stretches.

axes.proxy: share of deaths with a matched-rule trace
axes.note: King death: 'never stepped back', trace naming my rule, 'fixes · 12 replays of D33 · hp < 30% · foes ≥ 2 → retreat · survives 11/12 · was 2/12', APPLY; second King death honestly 'bad luck · 1 in 12 · forecast said D33 63%'. Lapse: first death 'gas · D13 · hero at 3 hp' showed no trace or fixes, only 'BUY pack 4' which then did 'D14 same'.
No people or developing relationships; heirs and workers are labels.
Self-set goal (beat the Mirror King), chose personality 'unbowed' unprompted; route 'D5 burrows' never mattered and order of descent is fixed.

All three layers seen: floors D4→D33, forge/legacy/tactics persistent, automation cadence high (scout 'SEND auto', porter, apprentice '+4 steps', drillmaster, keeper). Lapse: 'FORGED · D14 same' / 'D20 −25' and the apprentice silently spending 'purse −$12562'.

Torch-lit pixel dungeon, town that grows, red death banner are lovely on GPU; HUD chips overlap ('stolen fire potion' over 'Carried'), floor-chance wraps 'be hin d wa rlo rd', death banner text clipped at top. Audio unassessed.

axes.proxy: offline yield vs active; decisions pending on return
axes.note: 4h: 'While away 2 RUNS D33 $20185 · Boss defeated Lurker Queen · King weakness learned · cadence' and 8h: a death verdict with fixes to APPLY — real decisions each time. Lapse: 20m return was thin ('1 RUNS · D13 · shallower: D13, last D28') and led with 'purse −$12562'.

axes.proxy: share of deaths attributable to a rule the player wrote
axes.note: 'D13 · HP 39% → return', reel 'return at 30% got him out', 'throw fire mirror' and the King trace naming my return rule made deaths and saves mine. Lapse: second King death was paralysis/'no path' bad luck, and default 'attack nearest' does most of the fighting.

sameDayRetelling: Rook Ash, the second heir, cleared the Warlord and Bloat Mother on the way down, then walked through the Crypt and Foundry where the mirror read tactic I picked let him beat the reflecting Foundry Master. In the Deep he pushed past D24 to D28 with $17,620 already secured. At 30% hp my return rule turned him home and he banked $19,383, the run that paid for the whole kit.
